name: component-variant-variants-without-selector-param-are-rejected
source:
COMPONENT NoSel(in, out)
  out.mdot = in.mdot
  VARIANT a REQUIRE k
    out.h = in.h + k
  END
END
NoSel N(s1, s2, k=1)
s1.P    = 100000
s1.mdot = 3
s1.h    = 1000

error.message: Component 'n' (nosel): declares VARIANT blocks but no 'PARAM model$' selector to choose between them.
